verdict.rationale: Filee's docs say it can repack or extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, disk images and other archive formats using a bundled 7-Zip engine, and pack any files into one ZIP. Batch presets can also merge conversion output into a single ZIP, so archive handling is part of the conversion workflow itself. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on which formats are valid repack targets (e.g., whether RAR can be written or only read) and how options are controlled.
